prompt: A monochrome silverpoint character study: a single figure alone on plain off-white paper, drawn only in fine grey metalpoint lines and hatching, like a page from a Renaissance master's sketchbook. A demonic, monstrous creature, a starved demon that is humanoid only in outline. Its legs bend backward at the knee like a dog's hind legs, reverse-jointed, so it stands on its toes. Its stomach is sunken deep beneath the ribs, and its hairless skin is stretched tight. It has huge, long, pointed ears like a bat's. Its mouth gapes wide open, full of long, sharp, needle-like teeth. Its long arms end in long claws, and bony spikes run down its spine. It is hunched and crouched, snarling. Full-length figure: the whole body from head to feet inside the frame, isolated on blank paper. silverpoint study, metalpoint drawing, Renaissance sketch, hatching and cross-hatching, fine line, high contrast, sharp focus, monochrome, clean light paper ground
